description: This file is a server entry point for a Remix application, handling HTTP requests and server-side rendering, with support for bot detection and streaming responses.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function handling incoming requests, determining if the request is from a bot or a browser and delegating to appropriate handlers.
